items.title_en: Youngest Woman Grandmaster’: 11-year-old British-Indian chess prodigy Bodhana Sivanandan gets Guinness record
items.title_zh: 最年轻女特级大师：11岁英印国际象棋神童Bodhana Sivanandan获得吉尼斯纪录
items.summary_en: The 11-year-old from London achieved the feat at the 46th Chess Olympiad in Samarkand, Uzbekistan, last week.
items.summary_zh: 这位来自伦敦的 11 岁小将上周在乌兹别克斯坦撒马尔罕举行的第 46 届国际象棋奥林匹克竞赛中取得了这一壮举。

items.title_en: ‘Destroying our hills’: Manali traffic jam during long weekend sparks debate online
items.title_zh: “摧毁我们的山丘”：长周末马纳里交通拥堵引发网上争论
items.summary_en: Long queues of vehicles were reported from the entrance of the town towards Mall Road, Solang Nullah and the Atal Tunnel.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，从城镇入口前往 Mall Road、Solang Nullah 和 Atal 隧道的车辆排起了长队。

items.title_en: Top 10 Innovation Clusters in Global Innovation Index 2026: Bengaluru, Delhi in the top 30
items.title_zh: 2026年全球创新指数前10名创新集群：班加罗尔、德里跻身前30
items.summary_en: Shenzhen–Hong Kong–Guangzhou topped the Global Innovation Index 2026 as the World's most innovative cluster.
items.summary_zh: 深港广位居2026年全球创新指数榜首，成为全球最具创新力的集群。

items.title_en: Mexico’s National Guard has a new recruit: An 8-inch Chihuahua
items.title_zh: 墨西哥国民警卫队招募新兵：8英寸吉娃娃犬
items.summary_en: The tiny dog recently took part in a training session in Mexico City, where he was seen wearing a miniature tactical vest, goggles and a small camera mounted on his head.
items.summary_zh: 这只小狗最近参加了墨西哥城的一次训练，人们看到它穿着微型战术背心，戴着护目镜，头上安装了一个小型相机。
